player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee leek {player_id} ({piece}). Yin ee raan ({opp}). Cëët akïïn kuat yic '[b1 c3]' (nei → lo). Akïïn kuat wïïr thïïïn chess knights.
Këër wïïr thïïïn {score_per_capture} alama. Tëëër akïïn kuat yök ëë {max_moves} kuat yök, ku wïïr leek acïïn raan tïïïnë kuat yök / acïïn akïïn kuat. Alama këër ee wïïn.

invalid_move.not_your_piece: Acie këdu yen ye yök thïn.
invalid_move.own_piece: Acie lëu bï piny la cuat nhom.

game_action.moved: Wëlcuëi {player_id} acë mäc lööc ku{frm} gɛm ku{to}.

outcome.cannot_move: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acïï lëu bï lɔ.
outcome.higher_score: Aŋuɛ̈n ba kë cï yök ya juak.
